topic: Day 138 — reel — You can fix the logistics of being alone and still feel lonely
text:
A full calendar
fixes the
[logistics], not
the loneliness.
caption:
Contact and connection are different measurements. A packed week and persistent isolation coexist more often than anyone admits.

Follow for one of these a day.
